sourceReview.detail: Date from department instruction 'next week phyto is an exam for group A', anchored to 2026-11-13 -> Thursday of the week of 21 Nov = 2026-11-26. Times reuse the printed practical slots (Group-1 slot 13:00-14:50, Group-2 slot 15:00-16:50) restricted to subdivision A. The weekly practical does not materialize on this date (its validity window ends 2026-11-25), so there is no cancelled remnant and no exception row.

Date from department instruction 'the week after that is an exam for group B', anchored to 2026-11-13 -> Thursday of the week of 28 Nov = 2026-12-03. Times reuse the printed practical slots restricted to subdivision B. The weekly practical does not materialize on this date (its window resumes 2026-12-04), so there is no cancelled remnant and no exception row.
